text: Professional OverviewThe major of mechanical engineering belongs to the category of engineering. It lasts for four years and confers a Bachelor of Engineering degree. It covers multiple aspects such as mechanical design, mechanical manufacturing, and mechatronic engineering, and features professional characteristics like advanced manufacturing technology and mechatronic control. Its research content includes the design of mechanical products, the formulation of manufacturing processes, the operation and control of mechanical systems, etc., aiming to cultivate professional talents who can solve practical problems in the field of mechanical engineering.Training objectivesThis major aims to cultivate compound senior engineering and technical talents with a solid foundation in the basic theories and knowledge of mechanical engineering, who can engage in engineering design, mechanical manufacturing, technology development, scientific research, production organization and management and other aspects of work in the field of mechanical engineering. Enable students to possess engineering awareness, engineering quality, engineering practice ability and certain innovation ability, and become professional talents with international competitiveness.
